serviceDescription: The MegaplanIT FedRAMP 3PAO provides comprehensive IT auditing and penetration testing services for customers interested in an independent, third-party FedRAMP assessment. We maintain a suite of 3PAO services to assist CSPs through their FedRAMP certification process, which include: Readiness assessment, Security package development, Remediation services, 3PAO security assessment, and 3PAO continuous monitoring services.
